displayname: BBC Good Food - Healthy recipes cookbook
description: Healthy food needn't be boring! This app has over 195 recipes for you to incorporate into your day-to-day cooking. More than 195 recipes to help tempt you to cook and eat healthily year-round, including Salmon & ginger fish cakes, Thai beef stir-fry and Indian butternut squash curry. Once you've downloaded the app, you can use and search the recipes at any time, even offline. There's something for everyone, and every meal (including breakfast). The app contains over 35 recipes that have less than 200 calories per portion, as well as healthy twists on classic dishes, like Chicken korma and Choc
